title: "Privacy"
description: "What RafikiArdhi collects when you visit this site (very little) and what our free tools do with the numbers you enter (nothing: they never leave your browser)."
---

*Last updated: October 2026*

The short version: our tools run entirely in your browser and store nothing; we use Google Analytics to count visits; we don't have accounts, don't sell anything about you, and don't show ads.

## The tools

Our tools run entirely in your web browser. When you open a file, it is read and processed on your own computer, and results are saved directly back to it. No data is transmitted to RafikiArdhi or any third party, and nothing is stored on our servers. We don't have a database. That makes the tools safe for confidential data, unpublished results and manuscripts under review.

- **Share links.** Some tools put your inputs into the page address so that "Copy link" can recreate your calculation. That address stays in your browser unless you choose to share it.
- **Your units.** If you switch between US and metric units, your browser remembers the choice on your device. We never see it.
- **Check it yourself.** Once a tool page has loaded, disconnect from the internet. The tool still works, because nothing it does depends on our servers.

## Visit statistics

We use **Google Analytics** to understand how the site is used: which pages are visited, how people find us (for example from a search engine or another website), and roughly where visitors are and what devices they use. This helps us decide which tools to improve or build next.

- Google Analytics uses cookies and collects information such as the pages you view, your browser and device type, the website that referred you, and your approximate location (city or country level).
- Our site analytics record only page visits, never the contents of files or anything you enter into a tool. We have configured Google Analytics not to record the share-link part of page addresses.
- We can't see who you are. We only see totals and trends.
- Google processes this data under its own privacy policy: [policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). You can see how Google uses data from sites that use its services at [policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

**To opt out,** you can block cookies in your browser settings, use a browser or extension that blocks trackers, or install Google's [Analytics opt-out add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). The site and all the tools work exactly the same without them.

## If you contact us

If you email us, we use your name, address and message only to reply and to carry out any work you ask us for. We don't add you to mailing lists or share your details.

## Client projects

Data from paid projects is handled under the agreement for that project. It stays confidential, and results funded by a client are published only with their agreement.

## Children

This site isn't aimed at children, and we don't knowingly collect information from them.

## Changes

If we change how the site handles information, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

## Contact

RafikiArdhi LLC, Carbondale, Colorado, USA. Questions about privacy are welcome through our [contact page](contact.qmd).
